title: AURA Manifest (v0.1 draft)
description: JSON Schema for the AURA v0.1 manifest. This is a DRAFT and is intentionally non-restrictive: it validates the universal evidentiary envelope (version, identifier, issuer, timestamp, signature) and the common fields, while allowing profile-specific and future fields via additionalProperties. The authoritative references remain the signed test vectors (test-vectors/v0.1/) and specs/AURA_v0.1_Draft.md. Base/asset manifests SHOULD include 'asset' and 'origin'; scope profiles (e.g. PDS) use 'subject' and 'declared_scope'.

origin_proof_version.description: AURA proof format version (e.g. "0.1"). Not pinned, so future versions remain valid.

profiles.description: Optional proof profiles claimed (e.g. PDI, PDS).

type.description: Asset type label (audio, image, text, video, dataset, model, ...).

hash.description: Algorithm-prefixed digest. AURA v0.1 mandates SHA3-256 over the raw binary asset: the value MUST begin with 'sha3-256:' followed by the lowercase hex digest.

subject.description: For scope profiles (PDS): the target the declaration applies to.

declared_scope.description: For scope profiles (PDS): declared activities and policy.

issuer_id.description: Signing issuer identifier, resolvable via the TPKR.

tdm_opt_out.description: Machine-readable TDM / AI-training reservation signal (DSM Directive Art. 4).

claims.description: Optional explicit statement of what the manifest does / does not prove.

value.description: Signature over the canonical unsigned manifest.

public_key.description: Issuer public key when embedded; otherwise resolved via TPKR.

encoding.description: Encoding of the signature value (e.g. base64url).
